name: piebird-threads
description: Open threads in front of omp's agent: the project's open lines of work, in the folder its .omp/threads.json names, listed before a prompt whenever the list changes; a rule and skill on writing them

folder.title: Threads folder
folder.description: The folder of the project's open threads, one .md file each: relative to the project, or absolute. Empty: the folder the project's .omp/threads.json names, if any. Empty (the default here): as your piebird settings files say (~/.agents/piebird/settings.json, and a project's .agents/piebird/settings.json), which every agent reads.
